## Activity

During January 2020, Hill Counties Health Centre recorded 42 captures. This activity provides the basis for the site’s image-quality and grading review for the month. The recorded volume should continue to be monitored alongside the quality and grading outcomes so that any recurring operational issues can be identified and addressed promptly.

## Image quality

There were 2 ungradable captures, representing an ungradable rate of 4.8 per cent. The clinic lead asks that recurring camera issues are logged with the service desk. Consistent recording of these issues will support follow-up and help identify whether equipment or operating conditions are contributing to images that cannot be assessed.

## Grading

Grading identified 4 referable results. The median lag from capture to grading was 1 day. This indicates that the recorded grading workload was generally processed within a short timeframe during January 2020. Referable results should continue to be managed through the established clinical pathway, while the site maintains attention to image quality and timely submission.
